about_the_game:
The following content is included:

●Pendant: Dancing White Cat

This adorable pendant takes inspiration from ancient Japanese "haniwa" terracotta figurines. This one is regular-sized with cute little feet.

Enjoy the hunting life while equipped with a special pendant!

*You can apply pendants from the Appearance Menu in your tent.
*This product is also available as part of a set.
*You may need to update to the latest version of the game to use this content.
